caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle, showing both the front and left side. The chair has a high, slatted back with four horizontal curved slats, each progressively smaller toward the seat. The upright supports and rockers are rendered in a warm brown color, with visible wood grain. The arms of the chair are straight and supported by turned vertical posts. The seat is woven with a lighter tan material, possibly straw or rush, and has a slightly concave surface. The chair's legs and supports are cylindrical with turned details near the front legs. The drawing is set against a plain, light background with no additional objects or scenery. At the bottom right, the name "Adele Brooks" is written in small letters.
title: Shaker Chair - Rocker
